name: Brotherhood of Gix
aliases: monks from the Monastery of Gix
description: Gix's minions who infiltrated both sides of the Brothers' War.

description_citations.text: "Yawgmoth". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Brotherhood of Gix find their master's severed hand in Koilos.
timeline.quote: they found their master's severed hand.

citation.text: Claws of Gix (Urza's Saga, 1998), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Brotherhood of Gix finds their master's severed hand in the cave of Koilos and enshrines it.
timeline.quote: When the Brotherhood of Gix dug out the cave of Koilos they found their master's severed hand.

citation.text: Claws of Gix (Time Spiral Timeshifted, 2006), flavor text. Wizards of the Coast.

timeline.summary: The Brotherhood of Gix infiltrates both sides, leading to the Fall of Terisia City.
timeline.quote: both sides became infiltrated by a group of fanatical, machine-worshipping priests called the Brotherhood of Gix

citation.text: "Brothers' War", section "The War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mishra, having become the Brotherhood's puppet, is betrayed by them and turned over to Gix.
timeline.quote: Mishra was betrayed by them and turned over to Gix

citation.text: "Brothers' War", section "The War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Drafna and Hurkyl go to Terisia City and create the Union of the Third Path with the Archimandrite and the Brotherhood of Gix.
timeline.quote: they created the Union of the Third Path

citation.text: "College of Lat-Nam", section "Background". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Brotherhood of Gix's abbey is destroyed and its members scattered after the Battle of Teonacall.
timeline.quote: Its abbey was destroyed and its members scattered following the Battle of Teonacall.

citation.text: "Excerpts from The Antiquities War", section "Volume 2: The Urza-Mishra War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Delegates of various factions meet at the Ivory Tower council, taking a first step toward understanding mana.
timeline.quote: Sources state that the council of the Ivory Tower was attended by delegates representing various political, religious, and tribal affiliations present in Terisiare.

citation.text: "Excerpts from The Antiquities War", section "Volume 2: The Urza-Mishra War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mishra sends Hajar to besiege Terisia City, and after months the Brotherhood of Gix betrays the Third Path, leading to the city's fall.
timeline.quote: the Brotherhood of Gix betrayed the Third Path to Mishra, leading to the Fall of Terisia City .

citation.text: "Feldon", section "Betrayal". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: During the Brothers' War a demon enters Dominaria, takes over the monks' dreams, and announces himself as Gix at Koilos.
timeline.quote: then announced himself as that very same Gix.

citation.text: "Gix", section "The Brothers' War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashnod makes a counterfeit sylex as a decoy that fools the Brotherhood of Gix.
timeline.quote: This cylix was used to fool the Brotherhood of Gix

citation.text: "Golgothian Sylex", section "Discovery and use". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gix guides the Brotherhood of Gix across the desert to reactivate the portal, steps through and gives them his name.
timeline.quote: twelve of them arrived at the caves and reactivated the portal.

citation.text: "Koilos", section "Brothers’ War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Around 36 AR Gix is summoned to Mishra's Fortress, is burned by the Weakstone and decides to corrupt Mishra instead.
timeline.quote: seeking instead to corrupt Mishra and bring him over to the side of Phyrexia

citation.text: "Mishra", section "Pawn of Gix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Brotherhood of Gix becomes Mishra's council, banishes Ashnod and helps take Terisia City.
timeline.quote: they became Mishra's council

citation.text: "Mishra", section "Pawn of Gix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Mishra, weakened by lung disease, listens to the Brotherhood's body-modification practices and dismisses Hajar.
timeline.quote: dismissing loyal Hajar from the room to speak with the priests privately

citation.text: "Mishra", section "Pawn of Gix". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Gix reopens the portal and creates the Brotherhood of Gix, becoming Mishra's chief advisor.
timeline.quote: He lures and dominates more humans to create the Brotherhood of Gix

citation.text: "The Brothers' War (novel)", section "Plot". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Peace talks at Kroog end disastrously and mark the official start of the Brothers' War; the phyrexian demon enters Dominaria as Gix.
timeline.quote: a new peace conference in Kroog also ends disastrously and marks the official beginning of the Brothers' War .

citation.text: "Timeline/The Brothers' War", section "The War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Ashnod helps the captured Tawnos escape; the Brotherhood of Gix persuades Mishra to banish her.
timeline.quote: The Brotherhood of Gix discovers this and persuades Mishra to banish her.

citation.text: "Timeline/The Brothers' War", section "The War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The Gixians betray the Third Path; Hurkyl dies defending Terisia City and Loran flees with the Sylex.
timeline.quote: Hurkyl dies defending the city.

citation.text: "Timeline/The Brothers' War", section "The War". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: The First Talite Crusade purges the Gixian lands and destroys the Monastery of Gix.
timeline.quote: the nascent Church of Tal begins a crusade against artifice and magic

citation.text: "Timeline/The Brothers' War", section "Aftermath". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

timeline.summary: Urza and Mishra disturb the powerstone seal; Yawgmoth sends Gix through to manipulate their war.
timeline.quote: Yawgmoth sent Gix , now a fully compleated Phyrexian and a member of his Inner Circle , through the portal as a scout.

citation.text: "Yawgmoth", section "Sleeper agents". MTG Wiki contributors, CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, MTG Wiki contributors.

relations.note: The Brotherhood became his council and later betrayed him.
relations.quote: Mishra was betrayed by them and turned over to Gix
